name: natives
description: Natives — Chromium 文件管理、个人空间与隔离 Native Hosts

scripts.perf:files: npm run extension:check && node scripts/perf/architecture-check.mjs && npm run perf:extension && npm run perf:extension:test && npm run perf:native-host && npm run perf:model-host
scripts.perf:check: npm run perf:files && npm run apps:check
scripts.extension:check: npm run standards:check && node extension/check-syntax.mjs && node extension/screenshot.test.mjs && node extension/files-session.test.mjs && node extension/files-paths.test.mjs && node extension/files-markdown.test.mjs && node extension/native-client.test.mjs && node extension/model-settings.test.mjs && node extension/model-oauth-subviews.test.mjs && node extension/model-agent-view.test.mjs && node extension/plugins-cache.test.mjs && node extension/app-navigation-projection.test.mjs && node extension/apps.test.mjs && node extension/app-boot.test.mjs && node extension/app-surface-boundary.test.mjs && node extension/space-modals.test.mjs && node extension/space-plugins-smoke.test.mjs && node extension/space-deep-verify.test.mjs && node extension/space-widgets-structural.test.mjs && node extension/space-inspector.test.mjs && node extension/space.test.mjs && node extension/ai-performance.test.mjs && node extension/tests/ai-drilldown.test.mjs && node extension/tests/ai-legacy-migration.test.mjs && node extension/check-lifecycle.mjs && node extension/dev.mjs --self-test
scripts.extension:host:build: rtk env -u CARGO_TARGET_DIR cargo build -p native-file-host
scripts.extension:host:build:release: rtk env -u CARGO_TARGET_DIR cargo build -p native-file-host --release
scripts.model:host:build: mkdir -p target/debug && cd model-host && rtk go build -o ../target/debug/model-host .
scripts.model:host:build:release: mkdir -p target/release && cd model-host && rtk go build -trimpath -ldflags=-s -o ../target/release/model-host .
scripts.extension:release: npm run extension:host:build:release && npm run model:host:build:release && npm run extension:package && npm run perf:check
scripts.apps:check: npm run standards:check && npm run apps:contract:check && node scripts/apps/check-registry-equality.mjs && node scripts/apps/check-architecture-death.mjs && npm run apps:security:check
scripts.statusbar: clang -O2 -framework AppKit -framework Foundation -framework WebKit -lsqlite3 -I installers/macos/resources installers/macos/resources/launcher-main.m installers/macos/resources/NativesStatusBar.m -o target/debug/natives-statusbar && ./target/debug/natives-statusbar --status-bar
